# BaxterPro

> BaxterPro is a medical malpractice insurance agency specializing in professional liability coverage for healthcare professionals across multiple specialties.

BaxterPro (Baxter & Associates) provides tailored medical malpractice and professional liability insurance solutions for physicians, advanced practice nurses, physician assistants, dentists, chiropractors, and podiatrists. The agency offers both occurrence and claims-made policies with coverage options designed for individual practitioners and group medical practices.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice Insurance
- Professional Liability Insurance
- Occurrence Policy
- Claims-Made Policy
- Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
- Nurse Practitioners (ARNP/APRN)
- Physician Assistants (PA)
- Prior Acts Coverage
- Healthcare Professionals
- Group Medical Malpractice Insurance
- Dental Professional Liability
- Chiropractic Insurance
- Podiatrist Liability Insurance
- AM Best Rated Carriers
- Risk Management
